messages:
Maya: Heads-up — we're seeing a perf spike the last ~2h on the continuous-batching path. p50 looks fine but p99 is up ~250ms on routes that hit cold KV-cache. Thinking we need a focused dashboard to correlate batch-size distribution, kv-hit-rate, and per-token decode time.

Jordan: Agreed. Can we also add reservoir sampling for queue wait so a few long-tail requests don't drown the histograms? :thinking_face:

Alex: Sketch of panels I think we need: batch_size histogram (buckets 1,2,4,8,16,32,64), queue_wait p50/p95/p99, kv_cache_hit_ratio, token_decode_ms per-token histogram, kernel_switch_count per minute. Also an index that shows requests with tiny batch sizes and high decode ms.

Priya: Per-route KPIs are crucial — throughput (req/s), tokens/s, p99 latency, and eviction spikes. If eviction spikes precede tail latency, that's our smoking gun for KV cold starts.

Maya: Posting some PromQL snippets I tried in dev so folks can copy/paste: 

Alex: (paste)
```
# p95 queue wait per route
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(queue_wait_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))

# kv cache hit ratio by route
sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total[5m])) by (route)

# tokens decoded per second per backend
sum(rate(decoded_tokens_total[1m])) by (backend)

# scheduler packing efficiency (usable / ideal)
sum(rate(usable_batch_size_sum[5m])) / sum(rate(ideal_batch_size_sum[5m]))
```

Jordan: Nice. Can we make an alert that triggers when p99(token_latency) > 500ms AND kv_hit_rate < 0.7 for 5m? That should catch regressions that are KV-driven rather than load-driven.

Alex: Yep — I'll add that. Also will create a small table panel that shows recent kernel switches for tail requests with the attached request_id so runtime folks can trace.

chris-bot: deploy-bot: dashboard 'reservoir-queueing-token-breakdown-v1' created in staging by Alex.

Priya: Suggest we add a synthetic probe (small prompt set) hitting a range of routes every 10m to exercise low-batch codepaths and measure token-level times. Helps detect regressions early.

Maya: Next steps -> Alex builds the dashboard and the composite alert, Jordan adds reservoir sampling to the queue exporter, Priya wires the synthetic checks. We'll review Monday sync with a 15m demo. :thumbsup:
